function: Excluded (function): the learned DQN only moves a single receive movable antenna to maximize channel gain (p. 4), which is none of the seven areas.
notes: Exclude, function. p. 4: "we utilize a Deep Q-Network (DQN) combined with the SBLVI channel estimation method to optimize the antenna position". The delay-Doppler channel estimation is SBLVI, an iterative variational Bayes algorithm without trained parameters (p. 4, Algorithm 1), so no learned method does area 4. Single antennas at BS and receiver, no beams or RIS (p. 2, p. 3: "We use a single antenna at the receiver"). If the reviewer counted SBLVI as learned, the work would be area 4.
